pile_b_hidden.title: Clean Air Solar Farm Community Benefit Fund
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Voluntary organisations, community groups and small charitable organisations based in or serving the communities within the area of benefit.

pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK-registered organisations of any size or type. You can lead only one application but participate as a delivery partner in others. Organisations must demonstrate commitment to continue developing the service beyond the funded project with additional resources.

pile_b_hidden.title: Community Action Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Community Grants Programme

pile_b_hidden.title: Community Hub Project Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Partnerships between at least one GLAM or Heritage organisation and at least one community group working collaboratively. Previously unsuccessful applicants can reapply with agreement from the Community Hub team.

pile_b_hidden.title: Community Wellbeing and Mental Health Fund

Groups delivering activities for 2+ years can apply for up to £20,000 (18–24 months); groups active less than 2 years or piloting new services can apply for up to £5,000 (12 months). Not open to national charities, public bodies, schools (except PTAs), or animal welfare organisations.

pile_b_hidden.title: Company of Actuaries Charitable Trust
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK registered charities where a member of the Worshipful Company of Actuaries or another actuary is actively involved in a meaningful governance or volunteer role. Applicants must complete the contribution application form.

pile_b_hidden.title: Computers 4 Charity — Refurbished Hardware
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK-registered charities and community organisations. No minimum income threshold stated. The funder distributes equipment through partnerships with established charities rather than accepting direct applications from individual organisations.

pile_b_hidden.title: Constance Travis Community Endowment Fund

Social enterprises with a single person noted as persons with significant control (PSC) or where the majority of PSCs are related are excluded.

pile_b_hidden.title: Consumer Led Flexibility for the Clean Energy Superpower Mission
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK registered businesses of any size, research and technology organisations (RTOs), charities, not-for-profit organisations, public sector organisations, and academic institutions. pile_b_hidden.title: Corra Foundation — Alcohol and Drugs Fund: Children, Young People and Families Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Public bodies, Scottish charities, Scottish Charitable Incorporated Organisations (SCIOs), and Community Interest Companies (CICs). pile_b_hidden.title: Corra Foundation — Alcohol and Drugs Fund: Local Support Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Scottish charities, SCIOs, social enterprises, and constituted community/voluntary groups operating on a not-for-profit basis. Annual income must be up to £750,000. Your organisation must be delivering support in Scotland to people affected by alcohol and/or drugs and their families, and helping to deliver the Scottish Government's and COSLA's Alcohol and Drugs Strategic Plan.

pile_b_hidden.title: Corra Foundation — Alcohol and Drugs Fund: Partnership and Delivery Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Public bodies, Scottish charities, Scottish Charitable Incorporated Organisations (SCIOs), and Community Interest Companies (CICs). Private sector companies cannot apply. Only one application per organisation unless each is for work in a different Local Authority area.

pile_b_hidden.title: Corra Foundation — Henry Duncan Grants 2026

pile_b_hidden.title: Corra Foundation — YoYo Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: CultureStep

pile_b_hidden.title: D'Oyly Carte Charitable Trust

pile_b_hidden.title: Delamere Dairy Foundation

pile_b_hidden.title: Development Fund

Small grants of up to £500 may be available for organisations with income under £5,000 at the Grants Panel's discretion.

pile_b_hidden.title: Domestic Abuse Community Innovation Fund
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations, charitable companies (limited by guarantee), community interest companies, or constituted but unincorporated clubs or associations. pile_b_hidden.title: Dynamo Digital Inclusion Fund

pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Organisations eligible under the Community Foundation's standard grant-making criteria. Registered charities, CICs, and community organisations can apply. pile_b_hidden.title: Energy Resilience Fund — Key Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Environment & Sustainability Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Groups with a constitution and a bank account requiring two signatures. Registered charities and community organisations are eligible.

pile_b_hidden.title: Funding Futures Programme

pile_b_hidden.title: Gannochy Trust — Scotland Youth Development Grants

pile_b_hidden.title: General and Small Grants (Learning Disability)

pile_b_hidden.title: Good Finance

pile_b_hidden.title: Grants for Animal Rescue, Rehabilitation, Release and Rehoming

pile_b_hidden.title: Grants for Organisations

pile_b_hidden.title: Grants for Wales

No direct funding to individuals, schools, hospices, or businesses.

pile_b_hidden.title: Green Quarter Community Chest

pile_b_hidden.title: Green Roots Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Hackney — Project Innovation Fund

Must have a bank account in their organisation's name or access to a host organisation. Annual income must be under £250,000. At least 80% of beneficiaries must be Hackney residents. Private businesses and individuals cannot apply.

pile_b_hidden.title: HCF Grants

pile_b_hidden.title: Heart Research UK — Healthy Heart Grants

pile_b_hidden.title: Henry Smith Foundation Grants

pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK-based registered charities and smaller charitable organisations. For overseas programmes, organisations physically based in the target country (Malawi, Tanzania, or Uganda) and run by local people are preferred.

pile_b_hidden.title: IM Properties Stratford 46 Community Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Inspiring Lewisham Communities Fund 2026

pile_b_hidden.title: J N Derbyshire Trust

pile_b_hidden.title: JRCT — Sustainable Future Programme

pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK-registered nonprofit organisations only, including charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, Community Interest Companies, Companies Limited by Guarantee, Excepted Charities, and unincorporated organisations with clear social purpose in governing documents. pile_b_hidden.title: Leicestershire & Rutland Community Foundation — Making Local Life Better Fund

pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Not-for-profit organisations including registered charities, voluntary groups, social enterprises, CICs, and Companies Limited by Guarantee. pile_b_hidden.title: LNER Customer & Community Investment Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Medworth Community Fund

pile_b_hidden.title: Peter Harrison Foundation — Active Lives

pile_b_hidden.title: R&D MAP Creative Content Exchange pilot: Early Adopters fund (Grant)

pile_b_hidden.title: Reducing Veteran Homelessness programme
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Registered charities with at least 5 years' experience in direct provision of housing for veterans; registered social housing providers (in England, Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland) with 5+ years' experience; local authorities; and Community Interest Companies (CICs) with relevant experience in supported housing for veterans.

pile_b_hidden.title: Resilience Fund
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Open to registered charities, CICs, and community groups operating in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly. No minimum income threshold stated.

pile_b_hidden.title: Richard and Siobhán Coward Foundation — Community Photography Grants
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK organisations, charities, community groups; artists/photographers leading projects, or organisations applying on their behalf.

pile_b_hidden.title: Rosa — Stand With Us Fund

Priority given to organisations led by and for Black and minoritised women and girls; organisations led by and for women and girls with disabilities; organisations led by and for LGBTQ+ women and girls; organisations operating in the top 10% most disadvantaged areas (IMD); and organisations based in Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland.

pile_b_hidden.title: Rusholme Wind Farm Fund
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Voluntary organisations, community groups, and small charitable organisations based in or serving the parishes of Newland, Drax, Long Drax, and Airmyn.

pile_b_hidden.title: Safer in Sussex Community Fund
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Local community groups, charities, and CICs based in or delivering projects within Sussex. Staff working with children, young people, or vulnerable adults must have DBS checks.

pile_b_hidden.title: Schroder Charity Trust Grant Programmes
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Registered charities and charitable organisations. No income cap or stage restriction stated.

pile_b_hidden.title: Seed Funding for Social Entrepreneurs
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: Individuals and social entrepreneurs leading new organisations no more than 12 months old. No specific legal structure is prescribed, but your organisation must have a clear social purpose and sustainable business model.

pile_b_hidden.title: Severn Trent Community Fund — New Project Funding

pile_b_hidden.title: Sir Halley Stewart Trust — Innovative Project Funding
pile_b_hidden.brief_who_can_apply: UK-based organisations only, including registered charities, CICs, and community groups. No minimum income requirement stated. pile_b_hidden.title: Sir John Fisher Foundation — Main Grants

Grants cannot exceed 20% of your current annual running costs.

pile_b_hidden.title: Small Grants for Charities

pile_b_hidden.title: Somerset Crisis and Resilience Alliance

The funder can consider applications including people under 65 (e.g. younger dementia sufferers or carers under 65) if you explain this in your application.

pile_b_hidden.title: Somerset Social Investment Programme

pile_b_hidden.title: Souter Charitable Trust — General Grants

pile_b_hidden.title: Sterry Family Foundation

pile_b_hidden.title: Supporting Change - Carers
